credits.title: Landscapes
credits.overview: Expelled from school, Alonso flees to Paris to meet his brother Pablo, who has cut all ties with his family and lives carelessly with his girlfriend Valeria. The sudden appearance of Alonso stirs Pablo's life exposing the brothers distant relationship and the lies in which he has built his new persona.

credits.title: Satán
credits.overview: Every day, Tiago goes into his garden to feed the crocodile that killed his brother.

credits.title: El Fin
credits.overview: Diana and Marco are a couple and also fans of a series of unfinished comics starring a mexican wrestler known as 'Máscara Escarlata'. Since they both have very different ideas about how the story should have ended, they decide to look for the creator of the series to end the discussion.
